name: A Hunter's Boast
summary: At Farstrider Lodge, A Hunter's Boast puts your skill to a timed test. Daryl the Youngling challenges you to slay six mountain buzzards in Loch Modan before fifteen minutes pass.

sections.title: A Young Marksman's Arrogance
sections.body: Daryl the Youngling boasts of his skill at Farstrider Lodge. He calls himself Daryl the Bold and dismisses travelers as greenhorns who cannot match his hunting prowess. To prove it, he wagers that you cannot kill six local mountain buzzards within fifteen minutes.

sections.title: Thinning the Scavengers
sections.body: Mountain buzzards scavenge and prey on smaller wildlife around Loch Modan's crags and hillsides. Daryl's timed hunt tests your speed, patience, and aim. If you bring down six before time runs out, his pride takes a blow. He reluctantly gives up one of his ranged weapons, then sets further hunting dares.

faq.q: Where does this hunting challenge take place?
faq.answer: The challenge begins at Farstrider Lodge in southeastern Loch Modan. Mountain buzzards roam the nearby crags and open ridges across the zone.
Daryl the Youngling is a boastful young human staying at Farstrider Lodge. He calls himself Daryl the Bold and taunts travelers with timed hunts to prove his imagined superiority.

faq.q: Why is there a time limit on the hunt?
faq.answer: The fifteen-minute limit is part of Daryl's wager. He believes an ordinary traveler cannot bring down wild buzzards under pressure.

faq.q: What happens after beating Daryl's challenge?
faq.answer: Daryl is shocked when you succeed, but refuses to admit defeat. He honors his wager with a weapon, then offers another hunt, A Hunter's Challenge, for larger game.
Mountain buzzards gather around Loch Modan's rocky slopes. Their quick flight tests an archer's or rifleman's field discipline.

faq.q: Does this quest tie into the rest of Farstrider Lodge's tasks?
faq.answer: Daryl's hunts lead into a wider series for the lodge. It ends with a hunt for Ol' Sooty, the bear that scarred Daryl, as part of Vyrin Swiftwind's plan to get back at him.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can outshoot a boastful novice on his home ground and claim a reliable bow or gun.
As a dwarf, you know the lodge's seasoned hunters and can answer this young human's empty bravado with quiet skill.
As an Alliance member, you can take shelter at Farstrider Lodge, an outpost along Loch Modan's southeastern roads, and set out on hunts through the rugged valleys.
